vulnerable_statements.reason: The mapping is created with plain memremap() and never released. If the probe fails later, the mapping is leaked.

When the magic check fails (line 21), the probe returns an error without calling memunmap(cmd_db_header). The mapping leaks, and the global cmd_db_header keeps pointing at memory the failed device no longer owns.

suggested_fix: Use devm_memremap(&pdev->dev, rmem->base, rmem->size, MEMREMAP_WC) and check the result with IS_ERR(), so the mapping is released automatically when probe fails or the device is unbound. Another option is to call memunmap(cmd_db_header) and set cmd_db_header to NULL before returning -EINVAL on the magic-mismatch path.
